title: pfaffia hookeriana
intro: Pfaffia hookeriana, commonly known as Suma, is a plant native to South America, particularly in the tropical regions of Brazil, Argentina, and Uruguay. It has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and supporting immune function. The therapeutic actions of Pfaffia hookeriana include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and adaptogenic properties, which help the body adapt to stress and promote overall well-being. The bioactive constituents of Pfaffia hookeriana include saponins, flavonoids, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
